content.comment_body: Hello, Does the [product_name] support the SCADA IEC 104 protocol? Thanks

[product_name] [article_no] can communicate over Ethernet TCP/IP using the [version_no] protocol. [product_name] [version_no] or newer also supports Modbus TCP/IP communication. Edit: The latest [product_name] [version_no] is able to communicate with MQTT.
